title: Microsoft Build 2026: All the news about Windows, AI, RTX Spark, and more
brief: Microsoft Build 2026 showcased major announcements including the Majorana 2 quantum computing chip, Scout—an AI assistant built on OpenClaw, and Project Solara, a new Android-based OS for AI agent devices. The conference also featured Windows updates with enhanced Linux integration and a Surface mini PC optimized for AI developers.
